request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

limitations: Scalar multiply and add each count one; structural zero initial history is excluded.
SiLU is recorded separately, with no arbitrary FLOP-equivalent cost.
State reuse is derived from host flags; numerical zero values in live state are not treated as structural zeros.
Installed CANN source and wrapper behavior are inspected, not a reproducible source-to-binary build proof.
Rolling-path startup, duplicate partial sums, token padding and state copies are not effective convolution arithmetic.
r9 omits accepted-token offsets used for verification state reads; exact state-access replay is not established.
No device reference timing or full-model F/attainment is claimed by this catalog.
